name: io.github.cyanheads/chembl-mcp-server
description: Link compounds to protein targets, rank bioactivity, and look up drug mechanisms and indications.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: DataCanvas provider for the bioactivity spill and the chembl_dataframe_* SQL tools; DuckDB is the default. Set to 'none' to disable it: large bioactivity sets then inline a preview but never spill.

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the ChEMBL REST data API. Override for a private mirror or pinned host.

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds for an upstream ChEMBL request, capped by what is left of the call's time budget (45 s for most calls, CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS for a bioactivity spill).

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_MAX_PAGE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Rows per upstream ChEMBL page (max 1000). The bioactivity spill walks pages of this size; an inline bioactivity page requests its limit, capped at this size.

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_DEFAULT_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Default result limit applied when callers omit it.

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_MAX_SPILL_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on rows chembl_get_bioactivities stages to a DataCanvas table, and so on the upstream page walk behind it. Over the cap the response reports truncated: true and truncated_by: "row_cap".

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Most chembl_get_bioactivities spill-page requests in flight at once (1–6), shared by every call on the server.

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Time budget in milliseconds for one chembl_get_bioactivities spill, its count and page walk (10000–600000). At expiry the rows fetched so far stage with truncated: true and truncated_by: "time_budget".

environmentVariables.name: CHEMBL_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to register the opt-in chembl_dataframe_drop tool (absent from tools/list when off).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Selects the HTTP transport.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode to use: 'none', 'jwt', or 'oauth'.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
